messages:
Maya Ortiz: FYI I noticed the README quickstart for Python is inconsistent after the last SDK change. The curl example uses `--header 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY'` but the Python snippet expects `os.environ['REDWOOD_KEY']`. New users hit a 401 when they copy/paste.

Lucas Chen: Ah yeah, saw that in my onboarding walkthrough yesterday. Also the Python sample imports `aiohttp` but uses a synchronous client sample. Confusing.

Nina Patel: I reproduced — running the sample app from the repo with only the README steps -> 401, then traceback on import mismatch. Small PR to align env var names and swap the Python snippet to the sync SDK ready. Will push in a minute.

Maya Ortiz: Great. Can you also remove the manual retry loop at the bottom? The current SDK has built-in retry/backoff so folks get weird double-retries. Add a note about SDK automatic retries and how to opt out.

Lucas Chen: +1. Also add a tiny note showing how to enable the async client variant so parity is clear: many examples show only sync.

Nina Patel: Drafted code snippet I plan to push:
```python
import os
from redwood import RedwoodClient

client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_API_KEY'])
resp = client.generate('Write a haiku about compilers')
print(resp.text)
```
I'll include a short sentence: "This example uses the synchronous client. For async usage import `AsyncRedwoodClient` and `await` calls."

Maya Ortiz: Perfect. Also tweak the curl example to use the same env var name and show the header format we actually accept. Add a tiny callout about token scoping (embeddings vs generation) — folks copy the key into the wrong service and see permission errors.

Nina Patel: Pushed PR -> https://git.redwood/docs/pull/2710 contains: env var parity, sync snippet swap, removal of manual retry, and a note about token scopes. Requesting @docs review.

docs-bot: docs-bot: Added label `DX` and requested reviewers: @maya, @lucas.

Lucas Chen: Reviewed and left one nit about phrasing on the retry note. Minor.

Maya Ortiz: Approved the PR.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: docs site updated: https://docs.redwood.ai/quickstart — version 2026-03-22T14:56Z :rocket:

Nina Patel: Closing thread. Will follow up if we see more snippet drift in other quickstarts. Thx team :raised_hands:
